headline: Sequence-only foundation models extend to RNA, genomic tokenization, and allele-specific tasks
label: Nucleic Acid Foundation Models
summary: New preprints pair tokenization and relational modeling for DNA/RNA language models with lncRNA, protein-RNA affinity and personal-epigenome prediction.
synthesis: The dominant thread is pretrained language models over nucleotide sequence, with attention to how sequence is represented. BQDNA and HGDNA address genomic tokenization, using multi-head binary spherical quantization and overlapping k-mers respectively. RIPPLE learns sparse nucleotide relationships to improve RNA family, structure, contact, and splice-site prediction. LncRFM supplies an open lncRNA foundation model with the LncCorpus pretraining data and LncBench evaluation suite, reported to outperform RNA foundation models on lncRNA prediction. HARP-RPA applies protein and RNA language-model embeddings with pair features to protein-RNA binding affinity, and HapAdapter adapts DNA foundation models to allele-specific epigenomic effects. New here are domain-specific corpora and benchmarks, tokenizer design, and adapters for downstream tasks. The items contain no head-to-head comparison across these approaches.
